title: Real-time Customer Dashboards
facebook_comment_text: Those weekly reports? They often tell you *what went wrong* days ago, not *what's going wrong now*. Imagine catching a critical API slowdown or a conversion funnel bottleneck in real-time, preventing hours of lost revenue and customer frustration. 💡 What's the biggest 'I wish I knew this sooner' moment your team faced due to delayed data?
